name: dsh-agent
description: Chat with the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) coding agent inside VS Code, over ACP. Unofficial — not affiliated with DeepSeek. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/taokeqin/dsh-vscode-acp

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The extension spawns the dsh agent, which reads and writes files in the workspace.

dshAgent.executablePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `dsh` executable. Leave empty to search: PATH, then version-manager directories (nvm/fnm/volta/asdf/homebrew), then your login shell. Set it explicitly if discovery fails. Machine-scoped on purpose: a workspace must not be able to point this at an arbitrary binary.

dshAgent.profile.markdownDescription: The dsh profile to boot. Must speak ACP over stdio.

dshAgent.resumeLatestSession.markdownDescription: On open, resume the most recent persisted session for this workspace instead of creating a new one.

dshAgent.showThoughts.markdownDescription: Render the agent's reasoning (`agent_thought_chunk`) in a collapsed block.

dshAgent.replayHistory.markdownDescription: On resume, rebuild the transcript from dsh's on-disk session log. This reads dsh's **internal** file format, which carries no compatibility promise: if it fails the panel simply starts empty, chat is unaffected, and the reason is written to the DSH Agent output channel.

dshAgent.replayMaxEntries.markdownDescription: Maximum restored transcript entries (most recent kept).

dshAgent.panelColumn.markdownDescription: Where a session tab opens. `Beside` puts the chat in the column next to your code; `Active` opens it in the current column.

dshAgent.lockEditorGroup.markdownDescription: Lock the editor group holding session tabs, so opening a file lands in your code group instead of stacking on top of the conversation. Ignored when `dshAgent.panelColumn` is `Active`, where the session deliberately shares your group.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies -o dsh-agent.vsix
